cohort: Antenatal women experiencing first-trimester vaginal bleeding who visited a tertiary healthcare institution were followed up until termination of pregnancy or delivery.
finding: A large proportion of antenatal women with first-trimester vaginal bleeding experienced favorable perinatal outcomes, though some developed obstetric complications.
mod_finding: Approximately half of the deliveries (50.9%) were vaginal, and the other half (49.1%) were by cesarean section.
followup_time: until termination of pregnancy or delivery
